pages.text: The $(item)Structure Scanner$() captures any build as a blueprint.$(li)Right-click the $(l)first corner$()$(li)Right-click the $(l)opposite corner$()$(li)With a $(item)Blank Blueprint Disc$() anywhere in your inventory, right-click the air$(br2)The result is a written disc: portable and printable on any machine of the right tier.
Quartz gives the scanner its eyes; glass focuses the lens.
Each craft yields $(l)two$() blank discs. One disc holds one scan.

pages.title: Print, Don't Replace
pages.text: The printer $(l)never overwrites existing blocks$(): it only fills empty space. Clear the print area first, or the printer will skip occupied positions and build the rest.$(br2)Server operators can import WorldEdit $(l).schem$() and Create / vanilla $(l).nbt$() files straight onto discs with $(o)/mc3dprint import$().

pages.title: Scaffolding
pages.text: $(item)Scaffolding$() lands inside most hand scans. The printer acts as if it were not there: $(l)no cost$(), no effect on tier, and $(l)never built$().$(br2)Put it up, scan, tear it down. Without the rule a cottage scanned from a scaffold tower would come back needing a machine it never called for.
